name: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrame
title: EmbeddedAppFrame
wrapsNative: A bordered container with a content closure; ProgressView while loading; Link and MonarchButton for the failure actions
summary: A screen of another app shown inside this one, in a bordered frame that says when it is loading and when it did not open, with Try again and a link to open the page directly.
whenToUse: When one app shows a settings or detail screen that belongs to another app (App Settings), built natively with the other app's data or in a web view the app manages.
whenNotToUse: To open another app, use a Link or openURL. For web content from a third party, use MonarchEmbedBlock. For a card of your own content, use MonarchCard.
api: init(_ title: String, state: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameState = .ready, openURL: URL? = nil, height: CGFloat? = nil, labels: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels = MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content)
enum MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameState { case loading, ready, failed }
MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels.init(loading: String? = nil, errorTitle: String? = nil, errorDescription: String? = nil, retry: String? = nil, open: String? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the embedded screen, such as "Example Desk: Email notifications"; the frame's spoken name.

options.name: state
options.description: Loading, ready or failed; the app sets it.

options.name: openURL
options.description: The page, opened by "Open page" in the failure message.

options.name: height
options.description: A fixed height; without it the frame is as tall as its content.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, such as open: "Open in Example Desk".

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Loads the screen again; without it Try again is not shown.

options.name: content
options.description: The embedded screen, padded inside the frame.

states.name: ready
states.description: The content, padded, on the surface colour.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner and "Loading…" centred in the frame.

states.name: failed
states.description: A warning symbol, "This page didn’t open", the explanation, Try again and Open page.

appearance: The frame uses the surface colour with the subtle border and the container corner. The failure symbol uses the warning's strong colour; the explanation and the loading text the muted text colour. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web EmbeddedAppFrame loads another Rook app's page in a sandboxed iframe, checks its origin, waits for a ready message, sizes itself from resize messages and times out into the failure message. The contract is a browser one, so on iOS the frame draws no web content itself: the app shows the screen natively or in its own web view and sets the state. "Open in a new tab" becomes "Open page", which opens the page with the system. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The frame is a container named by title; its value is "Loading…" or "This page didn’t open" in those states.
The spinner is hidden from VoiceOver; the text says what is happening.
The failure title has the header trait; Try again is a button and Open page a link.
edgeCases: With a fixed height, content taller than the frame is clipped; let the frame size itself for settings forms.
Without onRetry and openURL the failure message has no actions.
